summary: Pulse Biosciences filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of up to $85 million of common stock through Mizuho Securities USA LLC as sales agent. The program replaces a prior August 2026 sales agreement under which 1,379,925 shares, about $68.8 million, were already sold; no sales occur until the remaining August capacity is used. Mizuho earns up to 3% gross commission. Shares will be sold in negotiated or at-the-market transactions on Nasdaq, where the last sale was $54.21 on September 14, 2026. This is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and pricing pressure given prior utilization.
